trailhead.label: Top station of the Texelbahn above Partschins, the board’s start

cautions: The Thousand Steps gorge: nearly a thousand steps of stone, wood and metal and a suspension bridge, hard on paws and joints; some dogs refuse the bridge, so carry a small dog and take it slowly.
Steep slopes beside the path in the gorge: keep your dog on a short lead.
Farm yards and pastures on the Sonnenberg: lead close past livestock.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
